title: Brindavana - The Sacred Samadhi
content: The Brindavana of Sri Raghavendra Swamy is the sacred samadhi monument.
description: The Brindavana is a beautiful silver casket containing the holy relics of Sri Raghavendra Swamy. It is the central shrine of the Matha and attracts thousands of devotees daily.
significance: According to his prophecy, Sri Raghavendra Swamy continues to reside in this Brindavana for the next 700 years, answering the prayers of his devotees.

features.name: Silver Casket
features.description: The Brindavana is enclosed in an ornate silver casket

features.name: Padiukas (Holy Footprints)
features.description: Replica of the guru's footprints is installed here

features.name: Prakara
features.description: The circumambulatory path around the Brindavana

pooja: Special pujas are performed at the Brindavana throughout the day, including Suprabhata (morning wake-up), Naivedyam, and Ekadasa Rudra Abhishekam.
darshanTimings: Darshan of the Brindavana is available during temple hours with special darshan tickets available for closer view.

rituals.name: Maharudra Abhishekam
rituals.description: Sacred bath with 11 types of holy waters
